name: hermes
description: A closed learning loop for Claude Code. Distills reusable procedures from your sessions into ~/.claude/skills/ at session end, counts which ones actually get used, and periodically curates them — archive the stale, pin the proven, never delete. Every run leaves a JSONL record, because the first version of this loop applied nothing at all for 16 days while looking perfectly healthy. The design is ported from the Hermes Agent (NousResearch) Curator; the code is independent, so the intelligence rides on whatever Claude model you point it at.
